lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters; smaller, higher-density clusters are visible immediately posterior to the gill slits, transitioning into larger, more widely spaced blobs towards the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Prominent vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible on the mid-to-posterior flank, intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, displaying a high-contrast transition from a light dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal organisms (Echeneidae) are present: one is attached to the mid-lateral flank, and several are swimming in close proximity beneath the pectoral fin region.
